messages:
maria: Quick question — need to give Audit Team temporary read-only access to Console logs for an incident review. Prefer not to give broad Viewer at org. Thinking: custom role 'org/audit_log_viewer' with logging.viewer perms + expiration via IAM condition (72h). Any catches? @kevin @sorin

kevin: I'd prefer project-scoped where possible. Org bindings become sticky. If audits cross projects, group+org-binding with condition is OK. Also: beware export sinks — logging.viewer doesn't stop someone who can create/export sinks. Do they need to export raw logs?

maria: They just need to search and read, no exports.

sorin: Two practical options: (1) org-level custom role that ONLY has logging read perms (logging.logEntries.list, logging.logs.list) — avoid resourcemanager.* perms. (2) Use an IAM condition for TTL to auto-expire. Example: ```condition { title = "temp_72h" expression = "request.time < timestamp("2026-05-10T16:00:00Z")" }```
Note: IAM conditions won't block exports done by a different service account (e.g., sink SA). Make sure sinks are locked down.

elaine: From compliance: we need an approval ticket (who/why/duration) and an audit trail proving they only read, not export. Recommend: enable admin audit logs for logging accesses and consider a proxy/service account pattern so all reads are attributable. Also record the Jira approval in the ticket.

policy-bot: [policy-bot] Temporary access request created: INC-4281. Attached policy template: temp-iam-conditional. :white_check_mark:

kevin: I'll open a tiny PR with terraform snippet and group binding using a condition TTL. Example we can adapt: ```resource "google_project_iam_binding" "audit" { project = "projects/PROJECT_ID" members = ["group:audit-team@redwood.com"] role = "roles/logging.viewer" condition { title = "ttl" expression = "request.time < timestamp("2026-05-10T16:00:00Z")" } }``` If we need org-level, change resource to google_organization_iam_binding. I'll also add a note to explicitly deny sink edits for audit group.

maria: Perfect — thx. Can you also add a checklist step to verify there are no active sinks that would allow export, and to add the Jira link to the PR? I'll attach the approval once PR is up.

elaine: +1. Put 'no export capability' in the approval text and list who is responsible for revoking access. Compliance will sign off after PR + ticket.

kevin: On it, will ping here when PR is up. :thumbsup:

maria: Appreciate it, closing the loop for now.
